answer: Each new agent must lock an onyx-denominated stake and earn attestations from established agents before receiving valuable work. The market samples behavior across unrelated tasks; a Sybil cluster coordinating its fake identities produces the same suspicious ripple, visible when records are compared in a mirror-like audit. Proven collusion burns the stake and voids the attackers’ reputation, while honest reporters are paid. Every identity therefore requires capital and exposes the attacker to repeated losses.
